editorial.blurb: Giordano's serves iconic Chicago deep-dish pizza with a buttery, flaky crust and generous layers of cheese and toppings, backed by genuinely warm hospitality.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the cheesy garlic bread as a must-get appetizer, and don't skip the sampler platter—reviewers rave about the variety and sauces. Arrive during off-peak hours to avoid the 45+ minute waits at busier locations.
